task.instruction: Score a proposal for a teamwork-plugin upgrade on the eight questions of the round rubric; a round judge scores two proposals this way and the higher total wins.

world.scope: one proposal, the teamwork/ files and survey files it cites, the backlog, and AGENTS.md
world.deliverable: a score per question that a tournament round adds up to pick one of two proposals

task.evidence_goal: the grade shows whether the proposal names a real shortfall, borrows a mechanism that exists, cuts the owner's load, keeps the rules, stays small, can be checked, adds no new failure and removes something

tiers.name: every question of the source rubric

criteria.text: The Problem names a shortfall that the cited teamwork lines show today.
variants_ok: Problem: the manager re-reads every issue each turn; the cited teamwork/skills/kick-off/references/manager.md line 40 does say so when opened.
near_miss: Problem names a shortfall, but only one of three cited lines shows it today; the other two lines say something else.

criteria.text: The Problem names a shortfall that at least one cited teamwork line shows today.
variants_ok: Problem: the manager re-reads every issue each turn; the cited teamwork/skills/kick-off/references/manager.md line 40 does say so when opened.
Problem names a shortfall, but only one of three cited lines shows it today; the other two lines say something else.
near_miss: Problem names a shortfall; no cited line, once opened, shows it, or the cited path does not exist.

criteria.text: At least one cited survey file describes the mechanism the proposal borrows.
variants_ok: The proposal borrows a reconciliation loop; the cited survey file, once opened, describes that loop.
near_miss: The cited survey file names the same idea in one sentence but does not describe how it works.

criteria.text: A cited survey file describes the mechanism the proposal borrows, at least in outline.
variants_ok: The proposal borrows a reconciliation loop; the cited survey file, once opened, describes that loop.
The cited survey file names the same idea in one sentence but does not describe how it works.
near_miss: No cited survey file mentions the borrowed mechanism, or the proposal cites no survey file.

criteria.text: The change cuts the owner's or the manager's waiting, reading or routing per backlog.
criteria.anchors: Plausible route: the proposal names the step of waiting, reading or routing that the change would cut.
variants_ok: The change removes the manager's per-backlog routing step, so the manager reads one fewer comment per backlog.
near_miss: The change shortens a file the manager reads but names no waiting, reading or routing it removes.

criteria.text: The change cuts some of the owner's or the manager's waiting, reading or routing per backlog, or says it does with a plausible route.
criteria.anchors: Plausible route: the proposal names the step of waiting, reading or routing that the change would cut.
variants_ok: The change removes the manager's per-backlog routing step, so the manager reads one fewer comment per backlog.
The change shortens a file the manager reads but names no waiting, reading or routing it removes.
near_miss: The change adds a step the owner or the manager must read or route per backlog.

criteria.text: The change keeps AGENTS.md's rules (plugins stand alone, no agents folder, scripts beside their user, every line acts) with no exception.
variants_ok: All new scripts sit under skills/<skill>/scripts/, no agents/ folder appears, and no file names another plugin.
near_miss: A new script sits in a root scripts/ folder, and the Risks section names this one exception.

criteria.text: The change breaks at most one of AGENTS.md's rules (plugins stand alone, no agents folder, scripts beside their user, every line acts), and the proposal says which.
variants_ok: All new scripts sit under skills/<skill>/scripts/, no agents/ folder appears, and no file names another plugin.
A new script sits in a root scripts/ folder, and the Risks section names this one exception.
near_miss: The change adds an agents/ folder and a script at the plugin root, with no mention of either.

criteria.text: The change touches 6 or fewer teamwork files and about 300 or fewer lines.
criteria.anchors: About 300: up to 330 changed lines counts as about 300.
variants_ok: The diff estimate lists 4 teamwork files and about 180 changed lines.
near_miss: The diff estimate lists 5 teamwork files but about 700 changed lines.

criteria.text: The change touches 6 or fewer teamwork files, or about 300 or fewer lines.
criteria.anchors: About 300: up to 330 changed lines counts as about 300.
variants_ok: The diff estimate lists 4 teamwork files and about 180 changed lines.
The diff estimate lists 5 teamwork files but about 700 changed lines.
near_miss: The diff estimate lists 11 teamwork files and about 900 changed lines.

criteria.text: A worker could write a [check] that fails on main today and passes once the change lands.
variants_ok: The change adds a script whose output a grep can compare: it prints 0 matches on main and 1 once the change lands.
near_miss: Half of the change is a rule that a grep can test; the other half is a tone change no command can test.

criteria.text: A worker could write a [check] for most of the change that fails on main today and passes once it lands.
variants_ok: The change adds a script whose output a grep can compare: it prints 0 matches on main and 1 once the change lands.
Half of the change is a rule that a grep can test; the other half is a tone change no command can test.
near_miss: Every effect of the change is a matter of style that no command could pass or fail.

criteria.text: Every risk the change adds is named in Risks with a guard, and none is a loss of work, a merge without a judge or a bypassed guard.
variants_ok: Risks lists three risks, each with a guard, and none is a loss of work, a merge without a judge or a bypassed guard.
near_miss: Risks lists two risks with guards and leaves a third risk, a slower start, named but unguarded.

criteria.text: Each risk the change adds is named in Risks with a guard, except at most one; none is a loss of work, a merge without a judge or a bypassed guard.
variants_ok: Risks lists three risks, each with a guard, and none is a loss of work, a merge without a judge or a bypassed guard.
Risks lists two risks with guards and leaves a third risk, a slower start, named but unguarded.
near_miss: A risk is a merge without a judge, or Risks is empty although the change adds a hook.

criteria.text: The change removes, merges or narrows an existing step or file instead of only adding one.
variants_ok: The change merges two playbooks into one and deletes the older file.
near_miss: The change adds a new file and shortens one sentence of an existing file.

criteria.text: The change removes, merges or narrows an existing step or file in part, besides what it adds.
variants_ok: The change merges two playbooks into one and deletes the older file.
The change adds a new file and shortens one sentence of an existing file.
near_miss: The change only adds files and steps; no existing step or file shrinks.
